summary: Show the tickets selected by --ticket/--status in human dates output, let a lower --rate-limit cap the per-source request rates, and add that pacing to the multi-fetch deadline so snapshot rows still save.
reason: Publish review (PR #2291): the human dates table showed only the T1 summary; dates/snapshot/waits ignored --rate-limit; a slow --rate-limit then outlasted the fetch deadline and snapshot wrote with the expired context.
validated_outcome: go vet and go test ./... pass; dates --ticket T1,T7 prints a Selected tickets table.
